name: Meeting Recorder
description: Record a meeting (mic + system/video sound), live captions via Amazon Transcribe or on-device SenseVoice, timed screenshots; saved as a .htrans folder an agent can summarize.

params.description: AWS region used for Amazon Transcribe streaming (e.g. us-east-1). Amazon Transcribe engine only.
params.description_zh: Amazon Transcribe 流式转写使用的 AWS 区域（如 us-east-1）。仅用于 Amazon Transcribe 引擎。

params.description: Candidate languages for the "Auto" language option: 2–5 comma-separated Amazon Transcribe codes, one dialect per language (default Mandarin, Cantonese, English). Amazon Transcribe engine only.
params.description_zh: 「自动」语言选项的候选语言：2–5 个 Amazon Transcribe 语言代码，逗号分隔，同一语言只能选一种方言（默认普通话、粤语、英语）。仅用于 Amazon Transcribe 引擎。

secrets.description: AWS access key id for Amazon Transcribe. Leave empty to use the machine's default AWS credentials.
secrets.description_zh: AWS Access Key ID（Amazon Transcribe 用）。留空则使用本机默认的 AWS 凭证。

secrets.description: AWS secret access key for Amazon Transcribe. Leave empty to use the machine's default AWS credentials.
secrets.description_zh: AWS Secret Access Key（Amazon Transcribe 用）。留空则使用本机默认的 AWS 凭证。

secrets.description: AWS session token (only for temporary credentials) for Amazon Transcribe. Leave empty to use the machine's default AWS credentials.
secrets.description_zh: AWS Session Token（仅临时凭证需要）（Amazon Transcribe 用）。留空则使用本机默认的 AWS 凭证。
